# nso_global_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the Global Settings configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nso_global_settings" "example" {
  connect_timeout                        = 60
  read_timeout                           = 120
  write_timeout                          = 120
  no_wait_for_lock                       = false
  wait_for_lock_timeout                  = 60
  wait_for_lock_infinity                 = false
  ssh_keep_alive_interval                = 20
  ssh_keep_alive_count                   = 3
  ssh_algorithms_public_key              = ["ssh-rsa"]
  ssh_algorithms_kex                     = ["diffie-hellman-group14-sha1"]
  ssh_algorithms_mac                     = ["hmac-sha2-256"]
  ssh_algorithms_cipher                  = ["aes256-ctr"]
  ssh_algorithms_compression             = ["none"]
  ssh_algorithms_dh_group_min_size       = 1024
  ssh_algorithms_dh_group_preferred_size = 2048
  ssh_algorithms_dh_group_max_size       = 4096
  ned_keep_alive_interval                = 120
  ned_keep_alive_count                   = 3
  connect_retries_attempts               = 0
  connect_retries_timeout                = 3
  trace                                  = "false"
  trace_output                           = "file"
  ned_settings_use_confirmed_commit      = false
  ned_settings_use_validate              = false
  ned_settings_use_startup               = false
  ned_settings_use_transaction_id        = false
  ned_settings_use_private_candidate     = false
  ned_settings_use_junos_rollback        = false
  no_overwrite_enabled_by_default        = true
  no_overwrite_compare                   = "write-and-service-read-set"
  lsa_no_overwrite_enabled_by_default    = true
  lsa_no_overwrite_compare               = "write-and-service-read-set"
  out_of_sync_commit_behaviour           = "reject"
  use_lsa                                = false
  no_lsa                                 = false
  session_limits_max_sessions            = "unlimited"
  session_limits_connect_rate_burst      = "unlimited"
  session_limits_max_wait_time           = "10"
  session_pool_max_sessions              = "unlimited"
  session_pool_idle_time                 = 30
  session_pool_pool_max_sessions         = "200"
  commit_queue_enabled_by_default        = false
  commit_queue_atomic                    = true
  commit_queue_retry_attempts            = "unlimited"
  commit_queue_retry_timeout             = 30
  commit_queue_error_option              = "continue-on-error"
  commit_retries_attempts                = 0
  commit_retries_timeout                 = 3
  trace_dir                              = "./logs"
  report_multiple_errors                 = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `commit_queue_atomic` (Boolean) Whether commit queue operations are atomic.
- `commit_queue_enabled_by_default` (Boolean) Enable commit queue by default.
- `commit_queue_error_option` (String) Commit queue error handling option.
  - Choices: `continue-on-error`, `rollback-on-error`, `stop-on-error`
- `commit_queue_retry_attempts` (String) Number of commit queue retry attempts. A number, or unlimited.
- `commit_queue_retry_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds between commit queue retry attempts.
- `commit_retries_attempts` (Number) Number of commit retry attempts.
- `commit_retries_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds between commit retry attempts.
- `connect_retries_attempts` (Number) Number of connection retry attempts.
- `connect_retries_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds between connection retry attempts.
- `connect_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds for new connections.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967`
- `instance` (String) An instance name from the provider configuration.
- `lsa_no_overwrite_compare` (String) LSA no-overwrite comparison method. Only valid when enabled_by_default is true.
  - Choices: `write-set-only`, `write-and-full-read-set`, `write-and-service-read-set`
- `lsa_no_overwrite_enabled_by_default` (Boolean) Enable LSA no-overwrite by default.
- `ned_keep_alive_count` (Number) The number of NED keep alive messages before disconnect.
- `ned_keep_alive_interval` (Number) The NED keep alive interval in seconds.
- `ned_settings_use_confirmed_commit` (Boolean) Use confirmed commit toward the device.
- `ned_settings_use_junos_rollback` (Boolean) Use Junos rollback mechanism.
- `ned_settings_use_private_candidate` (Boolean) Use private candidate datastore toward the device.
- `ned_settings_use_startup` (Boolean) Use startup datastore toward the device.
- `ned_settings_use_transaction_id` (Boolean) Use transaction ID toward the device.
- `ned_settings_use_validate` (Boolean) Use validate toward the device.
- `no_lsa` (Boolean) Disable LSA.
- `no_overwrite_compare` (String) No-overwrite comparison method. Only valid when enabled_by_default is true.
  - Choices: `write-set-only`, `write-and-full-read-set`, `write-and-service-read-set`
- `no_overwrite_enabled_by_default` (Boolean) Enable no-overwrite by default.
- `no_wait_for_lock` (Boolean) Do not wait for the device lock, fail immediately.
- `out_of_sync_commit_behaviour` (String) How to handle out-of-sync devices during commit.
  - Choices: `reject`, `accept`
- `read_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds used when reading data.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967`
- `report_multiple_errors` (Boolean) Report multiple errors.
- `session_limits_connect_rate_burst` (String) Maximum burst of connections allowed. A number, or unlimited.
- `session_limits_max_sessions` (String) Maximum number of concurrent sessions. A number, or unlimited.
- `session_limits_max_wait_time` (String) Maximum time in seconds to wait for a session. A number, or unlimited.
- `session_pool_idle_time` (Number) Idle time in seconds before a pooled session is closed.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967`
- `session_pool_max_sessions` (String) Maximum number of pooled sessions. A number, or unlimited.
- `session_pool_pool_max_sessions` (String) Maximum number of sessions in the connection pool. A number, or unlimited.
- `ssh_algorithms_cipher` (List of String) A list of SSH cipher algorithms.
- `ssh_algorithms_compression` (List of String) A list of SSH compression algorithms.
- `ssh_algorithms_dh_group_max_size` (Number) Maximum size of the DH group.
  - Range: `1024`-`8192`
- `ssh_algorithms_dh_group_min_size` (Number) Minimum size of the DH group.
  - Range: `1024`-`8192`
- `ssh_algorithms_dh_group_preferred_size` (Number) Preferred size of the DH group.
  - Range: `1024`-`8192`
- `ssh_algorithms_kex` (List of String) A list of SSH key exchange algorithms.
- `ssh_algorithms_mac` (List of String) A list of SSH MAC algorithms.
- `ssh_algorithms_public_key` (List of String) A list of SSH public key algorithms.
- `ssh_keep_alive_count` (Number) The number of SSH keep alive messages before disconnect.
- `ssh_keep_alive_interval` (Number) The SSH keep alive interval in seconds.
- `trace` (String) Trace output control.
  - Choices: `raw`, `pretty`, `false`
- `trace_dir` (String) The directory for trace output files.
- `trace_output` (String) Where to send trace output.
  - Choices: `file`, `external`
- `use_lsa` (Boolean) Use LSA (Layered Service Architecture).
- `wait_for_lock_infinity` (Boolean) Wait indefinitely for the device lock.
- `wait_for_lock_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds to wait for device lock.
- `write_timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds used when writing data.
  - Range: `1`-`4294967`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The XPath of the object.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nso_global_settings.example ""
```
